cards.title: Eq. (11) geometry-dependence model
cards.role: Defines the same directed hopping model used for both square and rhombus Fig. 2 geometries.

checks.reason: The four coefficients and Laurent powers are transcribed directly from formal Eq. (11).
Substituting psi_(x,y)=beta_x^x beta_y^y into H[r,r+d]=t returns the four Laurent monomials exactly.

cards.numerical_form: hoppings = {(-1,0): 2.0, (1,-1): 0.5, (0,1): 1.5, (-1,1): 0.9}; keep H[r,r+d]=t only when r and r+d are both in the selected site set.

cards.title: Finite-size OBC spectral potential
cards.role: Turns independently diagonalized OBC eigenvalues into the finite-size potential used by convergence checks.

checks.reason: Transcribed directly from formal Eq. (2).
Replacing E_i by E_i+c and E by E+c leaves every absolute difference, and therefore phi, unchanged.

cards.title: Square-rhombus basis transformation
cards.role: Encodes lattice-cut geometry independently of the hopping model.

checks.reason: Forward transform is stated in Methods and Fig. 5; inverse follows from a 2x2 linear solve.
The equal-cut integer diamond |x|+|y|<=R has 1+2R(R+1) sites; R=30 gives the paper value N=1861.

cards.numerical_form: square_sites(Lx,Ly); diamond_sites(R) = {(x,y): |x|+|y|<=R}; cut_coordinate_interval_sites bounds u=x+y and v=-x+y, including off-centered integer intervals when required by parity/site count.
open_questions: The exact integer vertices for formal Fig. 4(d) 2:1 geometry are not stated.

cards.title: Eq. (15) reciprocal critical model
cards.role: Defines the reciprocal model used to expose critical boundary modes and spectral instability.

checks.reason: Expanding the two cosines in formal Eq. (15) gives x amplitudes 1 and y amplitudes 0.5i in both directions.
Opposite displacements have equal amplitudes, so every OBC matrix satisfies H^T=H.

cards.title: Scale-free boundary localization criterion

source_refs.value: Fig. 4(b) caption and Critical skin modes section

cards.role: Feature contract distinguishing critical boundary modes from fixed-length exponential skin modes.

checks.reason: The linear kappa versus 1/L behavior and zero TDL intercept are stated in the formal Fig. 4(b) caption.
For |psi(u)|^2=A exp[-kappa(u-u0)^2], the probability standard deviation is (2 kappa)^(-1/2); scale-free width proportional to sqrt(L) is therefore equivalent to kappa proportional to 1/L.
Across 15 radii, the fixed-target track gives R^2=0.99440 and a 95% thermodynamic-intercept interval [-8.33e-4, 2.08e-4]; neighboring target-energy tracks retain positive inverse-length slopes.

cards.numerical_form: Select the right eigenstate closest to a fixed target energy by deterministic shift-invert; fit |psi(u)|^2=A exp[-kappa(u-u0)^2] on one edge, then regress kappa against 1/L and require a positive slope plus a zero-compatible intercept.
open_questions: Selected eigenstate sequence and exact Gaussian fit window are not uniquely specified.

cards.title: Hierarchical geometry-adaptive spectral potential
cards.role: Predicts the geometry-specific thermodynamic spectral density and GBZ.

checks.reason: Main-text equations and Supplementary Notes 1-3 provide the formula and proof path.
The square-to-rhombus Laurent-exponent transform preserves Eq. (11) for arbitrary nonzero beta_1 and beta_2.
At the paper grid, mean absolute potential errors against independently generated finite-OBC spectra are 0.00667 (square) and 0.00623 (rhombus).

cards.numerical_form: geometry_adaptive_potential takes the minimum of two minimized cylindrical root potentials; spectral_density_from_potential applies Eq. (3) with the notebook's direct three-point centered Laplacian on the 99 x 99 interior grid.
open_questions: The paper does not state a minimizer tolerance; this run records 1e-5 and keeps finite-OBC potential-level validation evidence.

cards.title: Supplement Eq. (S17) separable benchmark and exact potential
cards.role: Defines the analytically tractable square-geometry benchmark used in Supplement Fig. S2.

checks.reason: The six Laurent coefficients, arcsine y-spectrum, and quartic-root potential are transcribed from Supplement Eqs. (S17)-(S22).
For square OBC the Hamiltonian is Hx tensor I plus I tensor Hy, so its L^2 eigenvalues are every pairwise sum of the two one-dimensional spectra.
The isolated smoke run produced all-finite arrays and exact-vs-Amoeba density correlation 0.9731 without reading source pixels or author arrays.

cards.numerical_form: Diagonalize the two one-dimensional OBC matrices, form pairwise eigenvalue sums, evaluate the exact quartic-root potential with arcsine quadrature, and independently minimize the Amoeba potential.

cards.title: Supplement Eqs. (S24)-(S26) double-chain critical NHSE
cards.latex: H(beta)=[[t_1L beta^{-1}+t_1R beta+V, delta],[delta,t_2L beta^{-1}+t_2R beta-V]]; w(E)=(2 pi i)^{-1} integral dk partial_k log det[H(k)-E]
cards.role: Defines the coupled Hatano-Nelson spectrum, profiles, and winding classification in Supplement Fig. S4.

checks.reason: All hopping, onsite, and coupling values are stated immediately below Supplement Eq. (S24).
The isolated smoke run finds zero net winding in the central region and nonzero winding in a representative wing, while both selected densities remain normalized.

cards.numerical_form: Build a 2L by 2L block-tridiagonal OBC matrix, diagonalize it for each declared L, compute selected right-state densities, and unwrap the phase of det[H(k)-E] along a closed momentum grid.
open_questions: The supplement does not uniquely identify every representative eigenstate used for the profile panel.

cards.title: Supplement Eq. (S27) nonreciprocal two-dimensional model
cards.latex: H=6 beta_x-4 beta_x^{-1}+6 beta_y-4 beta_y^{-1}+(1/2)(beta_x beta_y+beta_x beta_y^{-1}+beta_x^{-1} beta_y+beta_x^{-1} beta_y^{-1})
cards.role: Defines all six numerical panels of Supplement Fig. S5.

checks.reason: The eight directed hopping amplitudes follow term-by-term from Supplement Eq. (S27).
All four independently selected smoke eigenstates have normalized residual below 7e-15 and unit probability.

cards.numerical_form: Use the common site-set OBC builder for square and rhombus cuts; diagonalize the full spectrum and use sparse shift-invert only to select declared representative states.
open_questions: Supplement Fig. S5 does not print the complex energies used to select its representative eigenstates; declared targets are reconstructed and cannot be paper-exact.

cards.title: Supplement Eq. (S28) directional winding criterion

source_refs.value: Supplementary Eq. (S28) and Fig. S6, supplementary_information.pdf p.9

cards.latex: w(E;k_perp)=(2 pi i)^{-1} integral_0^{2 pi} dk_parallel partial_{k_parallel} log[H(k_parallel,k_perp)-E]
cards.role: Tests the sign-consistent normal-skin winding and sign-changing critical winding in Supplement Fig. S6.

checks.reason: The one-parameter winding integral and basis directions are stated in Supplement Note 6.
The isolated smoke run gives only 0/+1 for the normal square cut and both -1/+1 for the critical diagonal cut.

cards.numerical_form: Sample a closed k_parallel path at each transverse momentum and sum unwrapped phase increments of H-E; never infer the integer winding from a plotted color region.

cards.title: Supplement Eq. (S29) biorthogonal first-order disorder shift

source_refs.value: Supplementary Eq. (S29) and Fig. S7, supplementary_information.pdf pp.9-10

cards.role: Defines the perturbative disorder response plotted in Supplement Fig. S7.

checks.reason: The biorthogonal matrix element, uniform disorder interval, and averaging over all states are stated in Supplement Eq. (S29) and adjacent prose.
The isolated smoke run returns exactly zero at delta=0 and a nonzero response for positive disorder for both model families.

cards.numerical_form: Compute paired left/right eigensystems of the clean matrix, evaluate the diagonal-disorder matrix element divided by the biorthogonal overlap, and emit both |mean Delta E| and mean |Delta E|.
open_questions: Eq. (S29) is generally complex while Fig. S7 shows a positive scalar; the paper does not state whether it plots |mean Delta E| or mean |Delta E|.
The exact N=935 rhombus integer geometry is not specified.
